facts.fact: Agence Ecofin says, citing the Submarine Cable Map, that Cote d'Ivoire is linked to six international submarine cables.
Agence Ecofin says Guinea has only one fibre connection, mainly the ACE submarine cable to which it has been linked since 2014.
